prompt:
Implement apply_patch(text, diff) in src/unidiff/apply.py: apply a unified diff (as written by diff -u or git diff) to text and return the new text.
- Text and diff are split into lines at "\n" only; every line keeps its line ending (so "\r\n" stays as it is).
- Lines before a hunk header that are not part of a hunk (---, +++, diff, index and the like) are ignored. A diff with no hunks raises PatchError.
- A hunk is a header (see parse_hunk_header in src/unidiff/parse.py) followed by exactly as many lines as its counts say: " " context (counts for old and new), "-" removed (old), "+" added (new). An empty line inside a hunk is a context line for an empty line. A line "\ No newline at end of file" means the line just before it has no line ending. A hunk that ends early or contains any other line raises PatchError.
- Where a hunk applies: its old lines (context and removed) must match consecutive lines of the text exactly. Its expected position is its old start line (for an old count of 0 the new lines go right after that line; 0 means the start of the text) plus the offset at which the previous hunk was found (found position minus expected position; 0 for the first hunk). Try the expected position, then positions 1, 2, 3, ... lines away, the earlier one first at each distance. A hunk may not match before the end of the lines matched by the previous hunk. If no position matches, raise PatchFailed(n) with n the 1-based number of the hunk.
One test in tests/ fails; fix the bug behind it.
Add tests for the new behaviour. Run all tests with: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
notes: calibration candidate (4b), stdlib only, built by lab/tasks/build_tasks.py; traps: count left out means 1 (public); str.splitlines splits on form feed, \u2028 and \r; count-driven hunk bodies: '---'/'+++' lines inside a hunk; insertion hunk (old count 0) goes after the line; offset of the previous hunk carries over; nearest match, earlier first; no newline at end of file; blank context lines without the leading space
task_summary: Implement applying unified diffs to text (fuzzy offset search, no-newline markers, insertion hunks) and fix a failing hunk-header test; done when all unit tests pass.
